• Keep investing in junior talent
• Treat code review as a core quality engine, not a final checkbox

Now, it’s a portfolio of pricing decisions.

In today’s higher-rate operating environment, especially for private equity-backed companies under pressure to drive efficiency, this math matters.

Our view: sequence it.
Understand the seat. Govern the meter. Educate the users. Then let Cowork run.
